title: First bands heard as a child; Sam Morgan
summary: She remembers hearing Sam Morgan's band on trucks; she cannot recall its piano player. The tape is paused briefly.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: What was the first band of music that you heard live? Do you remember? What kind of music was it?

Well, we had a lot of records as children, but I can't recall. But then the first band whom I heard as a child was Sam Morgan and Rainey, and at that bunch, they would come over there as a child. And they would barely own trucks around the home. And they would've been lost. I would've been lost. I think that was about the first.
Hey, Sam Morgan, for instance. Remember, did you carry a piano player, did he? I don't think so. I don't know. What was the first band that you saw that was using a piano player?
Can I stop it for a second?
They're talking about the piano player. First piano player. You can't remember that part? I just don't remember that part.
